create_rotary_position_embedding: create a 1D rotary position embedding tensor using get_1d_rotary_pos_embed with a given dimension and position indices
build_bria_attention_module: build a BriaAttention module with configurable heads, head dimensions, and optional added KV projections for cross-attention
create_bria_transformer_block: create a BriaTransformerBlock with joint attention and feed-forward layers for both hidden states and encoder hidden states
build_bria_single_transformer_block: build a BriaSingleTransformerBlock that concatenates encoder and hidden states before applying attention and MLP operations
run_bria_transformer_2d_model: run the BriaTransformer2DModel forward pass with hidden states, encoder hidden states, timestep embeddings, and rotary position IDs
